emergence.summary: A multi-system primary ciliopathy: loss-of-function of BBS1 (the commonest BBS gene, archetype allele M390R) destabilises the BBSome ciliary-trafficking complex, so leptin-receptor / melanocortin signalling at the hypothalamic primary cilium fails -> the satiety drive is lost (hyperphagia, severe early-onset obesity), alongside rod-cone retinal degeneration, post-axial polydactyly and renal anomalies. Read on the hypothalamic melanocortin satiety axis: axis DOWN.
emergence.emergent_axis: hypothalamic melanocortin satiety signalling (energy-balance / adiposity set-point)

grades.perturbation_direction: [F] forced by (role x mechanism); cited biology
grades.perturbation_magnitude: [O] OPEN -- how far the switch moves is runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable

per_gene.note: M390R (the single commonest BBS allele, ~ a quarter of all BBS) destabilises the BBSome core; loss of BBSome-dependent ciliary trafficking of the leptin receptor / melanocortin machinery removes the DRIVE on the hypothalamic satiety axis (an accelerator whose loss under-drives the axis) -> hyperphagic obesity (plus the syndromic retinal / renal / skeletal features of the wider ciliopathy)
per_gene.src: Mykytyn 2002 Nat Genet 31:435 (BBS1 / M390R); Seo 2009 PNAS 106:1488 (BBSome leptin-receptor trafficking)

emergence.firewall: gamma reads promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only; perturbation DIRECTION is forced+cited; MAGNITUDE is [O] (runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable).

levers.push_direction: agonise MC4R, the satiety node DOWNSTREAM of the BBSome-dependent leptin-receptor trafficking defect -> restore the satiety signal the broken ciliary trafficking failed to deliver -> raise the under-driven satiety axis toward normal (axis UP). A DOWNSTREAM receptor bypass: it does NOT repair the BBSome / BBS1
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] degree of hyperphagia / adiposity normalisation not derived from sequence; downstream bypass of the ciliary-trafficking defect. Approved (FDA 2022) for BBS-associated obesity / hyperphagia ONLY -- the retinal degeneration and renal disease of the ciliopathy have NO approved therapy and are not addressed by this lever
levers.src: Haqq 2022 Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol 10:859 (setmelanotide in BBS); setmelanotide (Imcivree) FDA 2022 / EMA for BBS obesity

levers.push_direction: restore BBS1 / BBSome assembly and ciliary trafficking itself -> re-enable leptin-receptor / melanocortin trafficking at the cilium -> raise the satiety axis (axis UP); the switch-level corrective, repairing the deficient ciliary machinery rather than bypassing it (and, unlike the downstream bypass, the only arm that could also address the retinal / renal features)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] restored BBSome trafficking not derived from sequence; investigational, no approved BBS1 gene therapy
levers.src: BBSome ciliary-trafficking restoration principle; no approved BBS1 gene therapy

A DOWNSTREAM receptor bypass: it does NOT repair the BBSome / BBS1

Approved (FDA 2022) for BBS-associated obesity / hyperphagia ONLY -- the retinal degeneration and renal disease of the ciliopathy have NO approved therapy and are not addressed by this lever

treatment_A_switch.firewall: levers are DIRECTION + cited agent CLASS; not dose/potency/efficacy/safety, not a recommendation to treat any individual.

falsifiers.claim: BBS1 LOF moves the hypothalamic satiety axis DOWN (loss of BBSome-dependent leptin-melanocortin drive)
falsifiers.falsifier: a BBS1 LOF allele that INCREASES satiety / reduces adiposity, or a BBSome-deficient hypothalamus in which leptin-melanocortin signalling is enhanced rather than lost, refutes the under-driven (axis DOWN) direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: food-intake / body-weight and hypothalamic melanocortin-pathway readouts in a Bbs1-M390R model; adiposity by genotype in BBS cohorts

falsifiers.claim: agonising MC4R (setmelanotide) is the CORRECTIVE direction (raises the under-driven satiety axis) and acts downstream of the BBSome defect
falsifiers.falsifier: if MC4R agonism reduced rather than restored satiety signalling the 'potentiate downstream' lever sign is wrong; if setmelanotide were shown to repair BBSome trafficking the 'downstream bypass / does-not-repair-the-switch' classification is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: hyperphagia / weight response to setmelanotide in BBS; BBSome-trafficking assays before/after exposure

gate_falsifiers.gate: falsifier register (>=1 measurable falsifier per disease)
